source_title_actual: On the Mechanical Properties and Thermal Stability of a Recently Synthesized Monolayer Amorphous Carbon (arXiv:2002.04682; Levi C. Felix, Raphael M. Tromer, Luiz A. Ribeiro Junior, Douglas S. Galvao; 2020; Elsevier preprint)
catalog_note: Queue title '2002.04682_Combinatorial_Optimization_and_Submodular_Maximization_for_Team_Selection' is a mislabel: arXiv ID 2002.04682 resolves to the monolayer-amorphous-carbon paper actually contained in this file (verified against arxiv.org/abs/2002.04682). No team-selection or combinatorial-optimization content exists anywhere in the 10 pages. Primitives are extracted from the actual source; recommend correcting the queue title. No retraction notice found on page 1 or any page; original author prose, not a derivative summary.

primitives.name: Per-atom von Mises stress invariant from the virial stress tensor (Eq. 1)
primitives.verbatim_quote: The von Mises stress values provide useful information on the fracture dynamics from the starting stretching regime up to complete structural failure (fracture).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: sigma^k_v: per-atom von Mises (deviatoric) stress of atom k, units Pa = kg*m^-1*s^-2. sigma^k_xx, sigma^k_yy, sigma^k_zz: normal components of the per-atom virial stress tensor, Pa. sigma^k_xy, sigma^k_yz, sigma^k_zx: shear components, Pa. k: atom index, dimensionless label (610 atoms MAC / 640 atoms PG). Coefficients 6 and 1/2 and the square root: dimensionless. Every term under the root is Pa^2, so sigma^k_v is Pa: dimensionally homogeneous. Source prints Eq. (1) with Unicode math glyphs; this LaTeX reproduces the same structure, indices and coefficients exactly.
primitives.assumptions: Virial stress tensor correspondence with continuum media (ref [15]); fully-atomistic reactive MD with the AIREBO potential in LAMMPS; per-atom stress decomposition; uniaxial engineering strain rate 10^-6 fs^-1; finite boundary conditions on all simulation box walls; NVT thermalization at 300 K for 100 ps before stretching (p. 2).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Continuum correspondence is an approximation at sub-nanometer scale and degrades during reactive bond-breaking at fracture; per-atom virial partition is ambiguous at free edges and surfaces; the 10^-6 fs^-1 MD strain rate (~10^6 s^-1) is far above experimental quasi-static rates, so absolute stresses are rate-dependent; single realizations at 300 K in 610/640-atom cells (finite-size).
timescales: tau_0 ~ 1e-14 s: bond vibration / stress fluctuation
tau_1 = 4.8e-13 s: PG complete fracture (480 fs); MAC 1.16e-12 s (1160 fs)

layer2.mapping: The deviatoric scalar invariant of a multi-axial stress tensor binds to a per-player multi-axial load invariant in the 22-player football dynamical system: collision impulse (normal components) plus directional shear and rotational load (shear components) collapse to one scalar pressure index per player per snap. The paper's contrast - uniform von Mises accumulation in crystalline PG causing abrupt rupture versus localized concentration in amorphous MAC permitting reconstruction - is isomorphic to scheme-wide uniform pressure (one broken assignment cascades to total coverage failure) versus localized mismatch stress (one beaten defender, shell reconstructs). p1 supplies the invariant; the failure-mode contrast is p3.
layer2.telemetry: Per-player accelerometer/GPS impulse load, helmet impact kinematics, tracking-derived separation and leverage stress per play; calibrate the scalar invariant's failure threshold against observed coverage-collapse events. LATENT components: internal tissue load is not observable from broadcast tracking alone.

primitives.name: Quadratic stress-strain constitutive fit: Young's modulus E and negative third-order elastic modulus D (Table 1)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Both 퐸and 퐷are obtained from ﬁtting the quadratic regions of the stress-strain curves presented in the inset of Figure 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: sigma: engineering stress, Pa (GPa in Table 1). epsilon: engineering strain, dimensionless (Table 1 reports fracture strain epsilon_F in %). E: Young's modulus, Pa - MAC 249.14 GPa, PG 296.77 GPa. D: third-order elastic modulus, coefficient of epsilon^2, Pa - MAC -3.43 GPa, PG -5.32 GPa. epsilon_F: fracture strain, dimensionless - MAC 30.43%, PG 33.75%. TS: tensile strength = stress at fracture strain, Pa - MAC 51.90 GPa, PG 99.69 GPa. Each term E*epsilon and D*epsilon^2 has units Pa: dimensionally homogeneous. The quadratic form is the fit described in the p. 4 text ('fitting the quadratic regions'); the source does not print it as a numbered equation - E and D values are taken verbatim from Table 1 (p. 5).
primitives.assumptions: Uniaxial tension at 300 K, engineering strain rate 10^-6 fs^-1, AIREBO potential; fit restricted to the quadratic (weakly nonlinear elastic) region of the stress-strain curve before fracture; E and D extracted from the inset fits of Figure 2 (p. 4); epsilon_F defined as the strain at fracture onset and TS as the stress at that strain. Supporting quote (p. 4): the negative values obtained for 퐷indicate a decrease in stiﬀness as the strain increases, which in turn leads to an intrinsic strength[18].
primitives.breakdown_regime: The quadratic expansion fails outside the fitted region: at large strain MAC undergoes sequential structural reconstructions and stress drops that no smooth quadratic can represent; beyond epsilon_F the material fractures and the kernel is undefined; negative D means stiffness decreases with strain, so extrapolation past the fit window mis-prices softening; PG response is stretching-direction dependent (crystalline anisotropy) while MAC is claimed direction-independent.
timescales: tau_1 = 4.8e-13 to 1.16e-12 s: fracture window (480-1160 fs)
tau_3: tensile ramp at 1e-6 fs^-1 engineering strain rate

layer2.mapping: Derived load-response kernel for the football system: accumulated player load L (dimensionless, normalized) maps to performance output P via P(L) = P0*(1 - a*L - b*L^2) with b>0 the analog of negative D - marginal decrement grows with load. This is a derived kernel, not a source claim: the source invariant is the negative third-order modulus (stiffness decreases with strain). It binds as the fatigue transition kernel between plays: each snap applies load, the kernel prices the marginal output loss, and the fracture-strain analog is the load beyond which injury risk discontinuously rises.
layer2.telemetry: GPS high-speed-running distance and accelerometer load per session vs next-session sprint decrement; force-plate asymmetry; injury incidence vs cumulative-load curves. Calibrate a, b on held-out seasons; never fit on the rows used to score (held-out discipline).

primitives.name: Brittle versus sequential-metastable fracture dynamics: uniform vs localized stress concentration (PG 480 fs, MAC 1160 fs)
primitives.verbatim_quote: For MAC the high-stress values are concentrated at localized regions causing a fracture to occur on just some regions of the structure and allowing structural reconstructions, which results that MAC complete structural failure occurs later (1160 fs) than PG.
primitives.assumptions: Uniaxial stretch along x only, strain rate 10^-6 fs^-1, 300 K, finite boundaries; 610-atom MAC vs 640-atom PG; AIREBO reactive potential allowing bond breaking and LAC (linear atomic carbon chain) formation; single realization per protocol; PG fracture is direction-dependent in crystalline 2D materials (refs [24-27]) while MAC is claimed direction-independent due to absence of long-range periodicity. Supporting quotes (p. 4): PG presents practically one stage of elastic deformation, followed by an abrupt fracture, which is characteristic of a brittle behavior. | These bonds are the ﬁrst to break, and the PG is completely fractured at 480 fs (simulation time). | (p. 8): MAC exhibits localized fractures allowing structural reconstructions that prevents fast crack propagation and works as eﬃcient stress release mechanisms.
primitives.breakdown_regime: MD strain rates (~10^6 s^-1) are orders of magnitude above experiment, so the 480 fs / 1160 fs failure times are rate- and size-dependent simulation observables, not material constants; nm-scale cells (610/640 atoms) miss long-wavelength crack physics; results at 300 K only - thermal activation of reconstruction changes at other temperatures; the metastable-reconstruction pathway depends on AIREBO's accuracy for sp/sp2/sp3 rearrangements.
timescales: tau_1 = 4.8e-13 s: PG complete fracture (480 fs)
tau_2 = 1.16e-12 s: MAC complete failure (1160 fs), 2.4x delay
tau_3 = 1e-9 s: full tensile ramp duration

layer2.mapping: Failure-mode taxonomy binds to the 22-player system's collapse dynamics: crystalline order (PG) = rigid scheme with uniform stress accumulation and fast crack propagation - one failed assignment cascades to total breakdown; amorphous heterogeneity (MAC) = diverse personnel and leverages with localized stress concentration - failures stay local, the shell reconstructs through metastable intermediate states, and total collapse is delayed (the 2.4x failure-time ratio is the structural analog of bend-not-break survival time). LAC formation (load carried by reconfigured chains after local failure) maps to residual capability carried by reconfigured assignments after a local miss.
layer2.telemetry: Per-play EPA distribution and its tail; time-to-collapse of coverage shells from tracking data under sustained pressure; success-rate decay across consecutive high-stress plays; fraction of locally-failed plays that recover (reconstruction rate) versus cascade.

primitives.name: Thermal sublimation threshold under linear ramp: discontinuous solid-to-gas-like transition (PG 4095 K, MAC 3626 K)
primitives.verbatim_quote: considered here the temperatures for these transitions occur at 4095 K and 3626 K, for PG and MAC, respectively
primitives.assumptions: Heating from 100 K to 10000 K under periodic boundary conditions; NPT thermalization/equilibration before heating to remove residual stress and adjust box dimensions; linear temperature ramp over 1 ns (p. 3); AIREBO potential; 610/640-atom cells; transition temperatures derived from fitting the total-energy curves (Figure 4 inset, Figure S2); sublimation rather than melting for graphene at high T per ref [36]. Supporting quote (p. 5): The signiﬁcant discontinuity presented by both curves marks a phase transition from a solid to gas-like structures.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The 1 ns ramp (~10^13 K/s) is far faster than any experimental heating rate, so transition temperatures are rate-dependent (superheating); finite-size cells shift thresholds; no ensemble averaging or error bars reported; above ~6000 K the morphology is isolated atoms and 2-10-atom chain fragments (gas-like), so the 'melting line' label is operationally a sublimation line; the linear-energy-regime description fails at the discontinuity itself.
timescales: tau_0 ~ 1e-14 s: atomic vibration in the solid regime
tau_1 = 1e-9 s: full 100->10000 K ramp (1 ns)
tau_2: heating rate ~9.9e12 K/s (derived: 9900 K / 1e-9 s)

layer2.mapping: A monotonic drive with two linear compensation regimes separated by a latent-energy discontinuity binds to physiological decompensation thresholds in the football system: under rising heat/fatigue drive, output is maintained linearly (compensation) until a threshold where it discontinuously collapses (heat illness, exhaustion). MAC retaining 3626/4095 = 88.5% of PG's threshold despite structural disorder is the analog of a heterogeneous, well-conditioned roster retaining most of its collapse threshold despite personnel noise. The discontinuity warns against linear extrapolation of fatigue models past the threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Core temperature, heart-rate drift and HRV, sweat rate, session RPE vs output decrement; clinical heat-illness onset events; calibrate threshold and pre-threshold slope on held-out data. LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE: individual latent heat-tolerance state from broadcast data alone.

reasoning_traces.think: Begin from the source invariant and reason in both directions. Forward: Eq. (1) on page 3 of book 65c65dec7ddaacd5 builds a scalar, the per-atom von Mises stress, out of the six independent components of the virial stress tensor. A scalar invariant is exactly the right object to carry across domains, because it discards coordinate choice and keeps the failure-relevant magnitude. In the 22-player football dynamical system the analogous object is a per-player load invariant: normal collision impulses plus directional shear and rotational components, collapsed to one pressure index per snap. This is an explicit [ISOMORPHISM], not a claim that football players are carbon atoms; the licensed content is the mathematical structure - a deviatoric invariant predicts where a network fails, and uniform accumulation of that invariant across a crystalline network produces abrupt system-wide rupture, while localized concentration in a heterogeneous network permits sequential reconstruction. Backward: start from the observed football phenomenon and ask which invariant constrains it. A coverage shell that survives three consecutive pressures and then collapses entirely on the fourth is the signature of the pristine-graphene mode: stress accumulated uniformly, no local release channel, one broken assignment propagating like a fast crack. A shell that bends, gives up a short completion, and reconstructs is the monolayer-amorphous-carbon mode: the failure stayed local, the structure passed through a metastable intermediate, and total collapse was delayed. The paper quantifies that delay: 480 fs to complete fracture for PG versus 1160 fs for MAC, a factor of 2.4 purchased entirely by structural heterogeneity (page 4). The second invariant is the constitutive one: E and D come from fitting the quadratic regions of the stress-strain curves (page 4), and D is negative for both materials (-3.43 GPa MAC, -5.32 GPa PG, Table 1, page 5). Negative D means stiffness decreases as strain grows: marginal damage per unit load is increasing. Translated as a [DERIVED KERNEL], player output versus accumulated load is concave with a growing decrement, so the cost of the next snap is not constant but rises with the load already carried. The cross-check that keeps the mapping honest is the strength trade: MAC's Young's modulus is lower (249.14 versus 296.77 GPa) and its tensile strength is roughly half (51.90 versus 99.69 GPa), yet it fails later and more gracefully. Disorder trades peak strength for failure tolerance. The roster-construction analog is exact in structure and deliberately not exact in magnitude: a diversified lineup accepts lower peak projected output in exchange for a longer time-to-catastrophe when one component fails. The veto hook lives in the fit window: the quadratic kernel is only licensed inside the region the authors actually fitted; past the fracture strain the kernel is undefined, so any Coach-Mind simulation that extrapolates the softening kernel beyond observed load ranges must be vetoed before it prices a call. That is the bidirectional discipline: forward, the invariant licenses the mapping; backward, the observed collapse morphology identifies which mode the system is in; and the fit window bounds both.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The hidden state behind this paper is a ninety-year-old scar: Zachariasen's 1932 random-network picture of amorphous solids, long treated as a defect story against crystalline perfection. The 2020 Toh et al. Nature synthesis (reference [10], page 1) inverted that scar by producing a stable, fracture-resistant free-standing amorphous carbon monolayer, forcing this reactive-MD re-examination. The von Mises lineage runs from the 1913 yield criterion through the virial stress theorem to per-atom invariants. The football-side analog is the rigid-scheme lineage that treated personnel heterogeneity as noise rather than stress-release architecture.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Under pressure the beliefs clash recursively. The coach trusts the comfort call because repetition feels safe, modeling the defense as static; the DC models the coach's comfort tendency and concentrates stress on it; the QB models the pocket as reconstructing (MAC mode) while the protection may be in uniform-accumulation mode (PG). Each agent's model of the others is one level shallow: the coach does not model the DC modeling him. The failure-time contrast, 480 versus 1160 fs, is the physical analog of the clock mismatch that makes the QB systematically late.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Physics and physiology veto the high-EV call when the pricing kernel has left its validity domain. If the offensive line's cumulative load invariant is past the quadratic fit window, the softening kernel that priced fourth-and-short no longer exists, and the call is vetoed regardless of its fresh-state EV. If a receiver's heat-strain state approaches the decompensation discontinuity, the sprint output the deep shot assumes is on the far side of a phase change. The veto is structural: extrapolation past a fracture strain or a phase threshold is a category error.

reasoning_traces.think: The thermal protocol is the second half of the argument. Page 3 drives both monolayers from 100 K to 10000 K in a linear ramp of 1 ns under periodic boundary conditions, after NPT equilibration. Pages 5 and 6 report the result: total energy rises linearly in two almost-parallel regimes, then a significant discontinuity marks a phase transition from solid to gas-like structure, at 4095 K for PG and 3626 K for MAC. Forward reasoning: a monotonic drive with linear compensation regimes separated by a latent discontinuity is the canonical signature of a threshold system, and it binds to physiological decompensation - heat strain and fatigue - where output is maintained until a threshold and then collapses discontinuously. The striking datum is that MAC, the disordered material, retains 3626/4095 = 88.5 percent of the crystalline material's threshold. Heterogeneity cost almost nothing in threshold terms while buying a 2.4x delay in mechanical collapse. Backward reasoning: a fourth-quarter collapse or a heat-illness event is not evidence that the linear fatigue model was slightly mis-sloped; it is evidence that the system crossed a discontinuity the linear model cannot represent, which is why linear extrapolation past the threshold is a category error, not a calibration error. Now the recursive theory-of-mind layer, stated as beliefs under pressure. The coach's comfort call is a PG-like object: it loads the scheme uniformly, trusts crystalline repetition, and has one failure point - when the defense has seen the tendency, the whole call fails at once, like the 480 fs rupture. The defensive coordinator's tendency trap is the inverse operation: it concentrates stress locally, inviting the offense to load one channel until it breaks, which is exactly the localized-von-Mises strategy. The quarterback's internal clock is a time-to-collapse estimator calibrated on pocket failures; if his clock assumes the 1160 fs mode (reconstruction, extra time) while the protection is actually in the 480 fs mode (uniform stress, abrupt rupture), his throw timing is systematically late. Each agent models the others: the coach assumes the QB's clock matches the scheme's failure mode; the DC assumes the coach will retreat to comfort under pressure; the QB assumes the pocket will reconstruct. The cross-layer veto adjudicates when these beliefs collide with physics and physiology: a high-EV fourth-and-short call is vetoed when the line's cumulative load invariant sits past the quadratic fit window, because the kernel that priced the call no longer exists; a deep shot is vetoed when the receiver's heat-strain state is near the decompensation discontinuity, because the sprint output the play assumes is on the far side of a phase change. The veto is not a preference; it is the statement that the model used to compute EV has left its domain of validity.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The thermal result descends from two lineages: the graphene melting-point controversy, where atomistic simulations predicted 4000-6000 K (references [34-36], page 6) against an experimental sublimation picture near 4510 K (page 5), and the Fomin-Brazhkin finding that graphene sublimates rather than melts. The scar is the assumption that a disordered monolayer must be thermally fragile; MAC's 3626 K threshold, 88.5 percent of PG's, falsifies that inheritance and rewrites the prior for heterogeneity.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The coordinator's fourth-quarter belief state is the thermal analog: he models his players as still in the linear compensation regime because the scoreboard hides the discontinuity, while the sports-science staff models a decompensation threshold approaching. The opponent models the coordinator's denial and attacks the same channel repeatedly, driving the monotonic ramp faster. Recursive depth decides the game: the staff must model the coordinator modeling the players, and force the substitution before the phase change, not after.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: The clinical layer vetoes the competitive layer at the threshold: a player near heat-illness decompensation must be removed even when the win-probability model prices his continuation as positive, because the model is linear on the near side of a discontinuity and the downside is catastrophic and irreversible. The same veto structure as the fracture-strain bound: no EV computed inside a regime licenses action past its boundary. Medical telemetry, not the scoreboard, owns the threshold state.

universal_lens: A polymath audit lens for any system claiming robustness: ask whether its stress invariant accumulates uniformly (crystalline, single-point catastrophic failure) or releases locally (amorphous, sequential reconstruction); whether its load-response kernel is fitted only inside a bounded window; and whether its failure under monotonic drive is gradual or a latent discontinuity. Order buys peak strength; disorder buys failure tolerance and time.
gsi_mapping: The von Mises deviatoric invariant binds directly to axonal shear injury modeling: rotational head acceleration produces deviatoric strain in white matter, and tissue-level injury thresholds are scalar invariants of the strain tensor, calibrated by helmet impact kinematics. The negative-D softening kernel maps to ligament and tendon load-response; the sublimation discontinuity maps to bioenergetic decompensation and exertional heat illness, with core temperature, heart-rate drift and HRV as clinical telemetry.
gse_mapping: Coach-Mind sim gains a scheme-collapse kernel: brittle (uniform stress, fast cascade) versus sequential-metastable (localized failure, reconstruction, delayed collapse), calibrated on tracking-derived coverage-collapse events. Deception is induced stress localization - forcing the opponent's load into one channel. DFS and portfolio tail risk inherit the crystalline-versus-amorphous trade: concentrated lineups fail catastrophically on one injury; diversified lineups accept lower peak output for longer time-to-catastrophe. No odds inputs; internal only.
